scientific_integrity.computation_scope: Separate direct enumeration of 715550 subsets across ten biclique graphs, 1783 across 31 general graphs, and 136 support parameter pairs; finite tests not an infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: Exact all-finite-simple-graph subdivision transform; exact polynomial for all positive biclique shore sizes; balanced asymptotic invokes Ford (2008).
scientific_limitations: An equivalent special-family graph polynomial may exist in unindexed or inaccessible prior literature despite targeted searches.

title: Independent domination of subdivided bicliques: exact polynomials and multiplication-table gaps
